rv.q: Just so, in “Oratorio for Living Things,” Christian provides the notes but your body is the song.
The Oratorio for Living Things uses music to dissolve the listeners into their fundamental particles, then uses simple choreography and intimate eye contact to reorganize us.
The first hour of 'Oratorio' exerts a staggering power. Overwhelmed, I felt like the clapper in a giant, ringing bell.
The 'Oratorio for Living Things' is a miraculous, thought-provoking celebration of hope, life, and the human spirit, ravishingly expressed through a brilliant fusion of music and theater.
Together, the music and movement of Oratorio for Living Things create something vast, intimate, and spectacular.
She sets out to do the same thing with Oratorio and succeeds spectacularly with a ravishing score presented in a highly unusual concert hall.
After 24 months of isolation and loss, there’s a miraculous feel to this new music-theater piece.
